why: Cycle 12 of the expression area (docs/v3/cycles/expression-12.md) ran six native cases that had never run, again with no referenced case because TuffUI published no visualization after `f31ea2b` (its one newer commit, `79a2503`, fixes a link). All six passed in round 0: median 84 on all items, minimum 80; on F, K and X 82.5 and 79; on the F and K items 84.5. No P1 and no P2, the first cycle with none; one rubric finding says n52's F4 is a 1 by the rubric's letter, which would cap it at 79. It met every convergence clause it could measure for the third cycle; the referenced clause cannot be met while no `c` case can run, and the owner has not ruled on cycle 10's question, so the protocol stands. 36 of 64 lost points were `skill`, 19 `primitive` and 9 `planned`; X1 and X2 lost a point on 6 of 6 cases for the third cycle running, though every builder ran the fact count and wrote the one-view table. No case needed repair, so hypothesis 1's median lift was 0 by construction. Its fix rows (v3-expr-12-kit-fixes, v3-expr-12-skill, v3-expr-12-rubric) fix seven kit behaviours (the half-width fold, DataPanel heights at 390, the focus gap between cards and lists, the joined-row reveal in a DataPanel, a Heatmap held span, a frame group's error arm, labels in a dense cloud) and two partly-landed cycle-11 gaps, teach nine skill lessons including a fact count with a stop rule, and settle F4 for one measure at two grains. This cycle measures again on six cases that have never run. docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md is the protocol; it specialises docs/v3/CYCLES.md.

change: Follow docs/v3/EXPRESSION.md § The loop for cases n57, n58, n59, n60, n61 and n62 (all native; none has run). Before pinning, check TuffUI (github.com/yurigdesigner/tuffui) for visualization components published after `f31ea2b` (2026-11-16; cycles 7 to 12 found none; `79a2503` on 2026-11-19 changes one link); for each one, add a `c` case, its reference row and shot (`.evidence/v3-shots/expression-6/ref-shot.ts` in the main checkout shoots a page at 1440x1000 with reduced motion), and run it in place of a native case. With fewer than four referenced cases the cycle file reports the convergence clause on the referenced cases it has and says the clause cannot be met in full; with none, the verdict counts are empty. You are the lead: you spawn, shoot, collect and diagnose; you build nothing and score nothing. (1) Builders: one fresh subagent per case on the default worker tier, with the case row verbatim, the scenario id `expr-<case id>`, and the fence of cycle 12 (its builder prompt, `.evidence/v3-shots/expression-12/builder-prompt.md` in the main checkout, is the model; its lead tools, fill scripts and probe prompt are in the same directory). Pre-register the registry and scenario-info entries with placeholders so each builder owns one directory, run oxfmt on scenario-info.ts after adding them, and tell builders that `fixture` reaches the scenario as a prop. Each builder builds into its own dist directory and shoots its own route. (2) Shoot each scenario with apps/playground/scripts/shots.ts, plus the keyboard, list, reach and sweep frames and the BOX readings of cycle 12's lead tool (`lead-shots.ts` with `shoot-round.sh`). (3) Reviewers: one fresh subagent per case and round, never the builder, with the case row, the shot paths, a snapshot of the scenario source for that round, docs/v3/expression/rubric.md and the shoot log. Tell it to open every shot. (4) Repair: hand a case that scored under 80 its reviewer's findings, at most two more rounds, shooting and scoring after each. (5) Diagnose every point lost in round 0 into one class from EXPRESSION.md § Finding classes, using the builder's wish list and its workaround comments as evidence. Where an open plan row already owns a gap, class the finding `planned` and append it as a `notes` entry to that row's brief instead of filing a row. (6) Judge the three hypotheses against EXPRESSION.md § Thresholds, using this cycle's numbers and the verdict lines of docs/v3/spikes/viz-census.md; for hypothesis 1, report the per-case lift of the cases that were repaired beside the median lift, and say when no case was repaired. (7) File per CYCLES.md step 6. A fix that adds a public export, changes charts/contract.ts or changes what primitive-bypass denies is one row with `checkpoint: spec` and seat opus high. Report factory friction with `factory signal file`, not as a row. Lead notes from cycle 12: (a) check v3-expr-12-kit-fixes before round 0 on a build of the pinned master: n51 and n56 at 1800 (does the half-width table keep its columns), n52 and n55 at 390 against their loading frames (DataPanel heights), n52 and n55 at 390 and n55 at 1800 (the focus across the gap between cards and between two tables; n42 at 390 too), n51's reach frame (the joined row in a DataPanel), n54's list frame (a source row lights all its cells), n53 `?shot-state=error` (the error arm's height and its Retry buttons), n51 rest at 1800 and 390 (labels beside their dots), n46 at 390 (a rule across a zone caption) and n48 empty and error (the framed header); if any did not land, tell builders so the same gap does not cost twice; (b) check v3-expr-12-skill and tell nothing of it to builders beyond what ships; count how many builders end the fact count at zero; (c) check v3-expr-12-rubric and tell reviewers the F4 sentence; (d) run `make check-fast` on the round-0 tree before round 1 starts, never while a builder edits, and once only: in cycle 12 a REPL-awaited run moved to the background at 10 minutes and a second run started beside it failed in the quality matrix while the first rebuilt dist, so await it with a timeout past its length or read its log; (e) keep cycle 12's reviewer notes on the two sanctioned colour forms, the LIST approach, the REACH and BOX lines and the shipped fields; (f) keep the builder prompt's line to look at the page the way the skill's last step says, without naming the keys state, and count who shot a keyboard frame (cycle 12: 6 of 6); (g) `demo/series.ts` is shared: tell builders to change only their own group with one Edit after a fresh Read and never to rewrite the file, and to run `bun test` on its own; (h) once this cycle runs, the bank's only never-run cases are the ones it adds: add at least five from pages no case covers yet, so cycle 14 can draw six, and say so; (i) report every score on all items, on F, K and X without the R items and the cap, and, for the trend against cycles 1 and 2, on the F and K items alone; (j) read each LIST, REACH and SWEEP line against its frame and tell the reviewer what it hovered; (k) keep the line that lets builders write the skill's design file as `DESIGN.md` in their case directory; (l) an Agent call from a REPL script resolves to a launch receipt, not the worker's report: save each builder's and the diagnosis worker's report from its last message in its transcript (in cycle 12 the diagnosis worker's own Write of its draft was refused, so the transcript was the only copy); (m) cycles 10, 11 and 12 met every convergence clause they could measure, and the referenced clause cannot be met while no `c` case can run: if this cycle meets the measurable clauses again, say so in the convergence section, and if the owner has ruled on the question by then, apply the ruling.
